rating.zh: 影片评分统一采用 1–10 分，展示平均分和评分人数；暂无评分的影片显示暂无评分。当前平均分由初始评分总分及人数与后续用户评分合并计算。登录顾客可评分，无需在本站购票；同一账号对每部电影保留一条评分，修改后重新汇总。
rating.en: Film ratings use 1–10 points with an average and vote count. Films without ratings display No ratings yet. Initial rating totals and subsequent customer votes form one weighted average. Signed-in customers may rate without a booking. Each customer has one editable rating per film.

student.zh: 学生票资格在影院入场时核验；票价以场次公布的学生票价格为准。平台未规定具体证件类型，请向影院确认。
student.en: Student eligibility is checked at cinema admission. The screening's listed student fare applies. Specific accepted documents are not defined by this platform; check with the cinema.

hold.zh: 浏览、选中座位或收到 AI 推荐均不会占座。登录并确认座位、进入订单确认页后才整组暂留 5 分钟；不足 5 分钟开场时提前截止。刷新不延时，取消、超时或场次失效会释放；未付款不扣余额、不消耗券。 每次占座支持 1–12 人；每个顾客同一时间只能保留一组有效占座。
hold.en: Browsing, selecting seats and AI recommendations do not reserve seats. After sign-in and seat confirmation, the group is held for 5 minutes, ending earlier if the screening starts. Refreshing does not extend the hold. Cancellation, expiry or an invalid screening releases it; no payment or coupon is consumed before purchase. A hold supports 1–12 people; each customer can have only one active group hold at a time.

reschedule.zh: 主动改签仅限有效订单在原影院、同一影片、整单办理，人数和票种组合不变。距原场次开场至少 12 小时免费；6 至不足 12 小时收原实付票款的 5%；30 分钟至不足 6 小时收 20%；不足 30 分钟不允许。新票款沿用原折扣，多退少补，手续费另计；新单成功才释放旧座位，失败保留仍有效原票。
reschedule.en: Voluntary rescheduling applies to the entire valid booking at the same cinema for the same film, retaining party size and ticket types. Fees on the original paid ticket amount: at least 12 hours before the original start, free; 6 to under 12 hours, 5%; 30 minutes to under 6 hours, 20%; under 30 minutes, unavailable. The original discount carries forward; pay or receive the price difference plus any fee. Old seats are released only when the new booking succeeds.

coupon.zh: 影院原因变更会为每笔受影响的有效订单发放一张该门店五折券。券仅用于发券的具体影院门店，同品牌其他门店不可用；适用于一个新订单的全部票款，不限制原影片、人数、日期或厅型。成功订票才核销，失败不消耗。改签沿用原折扣，不重复核销原券，也不叠加新券。
coupon.en: Cinema-initiated changes issue one 50%-off coupon per affected valid booking. It is valid only at the issuing branch, not other branches of the brand, and covers all ticket fares in one new booking without retaining the original film, party size, date or hall. It is consumed only after successful purchase. Rescheduling carries forward the original discount without consuming the original coupon again or stacking another coupon.

payment.zh: 平台使用测试余额账户付款，不接真实支付渠道。购票和改签补款扣余额，退款退余额；余额不足不成交。登录后在正式订票页面确认票种、券和最终金额。AI 不读取你的余额，也不能付款或提交订单。
payment.en: This coursework platform uses a seeded test wallet, with no real payment gateway. Purchases and additional rescheduling charges debit the balance; refunds return to it. Insufficient balance prevents settlement. Sign in and confirm ticket types, coupons and the final amount on the booking page. The assistant cannot read your wallet, pay or submit bookings.

cancellation.zh: 影院调整时间、换厅或取消场次时，确认变更后取消受影响有效订单，退回当前有效订单实付票款及整条改签链累计已收的改签手续费，每单发放一张本影院五折券并发送站内通知。未付款占座直接释放，不退款发券；退款与发券不会重复执行。
cancellation.en: When a cinema confirms a time change, hall change or cancellation, affected valid bookings are cancelled. The current booking’s paid ticket fare and all rescheduling fees accumulated along its rescheduling chain are refunded, with one branch-specific 50%-off coupon and an in-site notice per booking. Unpaid holds are simply released. Refunds and coupons are not duplicated.
